about: The shared vocabulary of a run record: rnd's experiment.json runs and the Publisher's outcome.json. Co-owned by R&D (experiment.json and the mapping) and the Publisher (outcome.json and its writer); either side changes it only by agreement. Other repositories vendor this file at a pinned rnd commit.

outcomes.results: the run finished and its results are usable
outcomes.partial: the run stopped early but kept usable results
outcomes.test: a test or probe, not a counted run
outcomes.tooling-fault: our tooling failed after the run started
outcomes.lost-vm: a working VM or pod was lost mid-run
outcomes.cap-stop: the run hit its cost cap
outcomes.boot-fail: a pod or VM was rented and billed but never became reachable
outcomes.gate-reject: every VM failed the gate, so nothing ran
outcomes.refused: our own preflight refused before any VM or pod
outcomes.no-capacity: nothing could be rented; no cost
outcomes.stopped: stopped on purpose before any result

cost_bases.rate_x_runtime: the rate times the measured runtime
cost_bases.balance: the provider's balance before and after (offrig's measured ledger)
cost_bases.estimate: an estimate, when nothing was measured

id_rule: The window name as the Publisher writes it (14b, cpu-measure). A retry adds its try (14e-try4), since each try is a separate billed run. An offrig plan names its lane (publisher-plan4), since plan numbers repeat per project. Unique within an experiment.
